title: Pipe Symbol Signage
description:
Pipe Symbol (|) for MTR Signs:
A vertical bar is used to separate stations, lines, or directions in Minecraft MTR signs. Add a space before and after for clear, readable signage. Works with English and multilingual signs.
body:
Standalone Signage Resource Pack for MTR

This resource pack introduces a standalone signage system for Minecraft Transit Railway (MTR) using pipe symbols. It allows builders to create custom, independent railway signs that function separately from default MTR signage. Perfect for modern, futuristic, or realistic transit builds.

Features:

Custom sign textures using pipe symbols

Independent directional signs for stations, tram lines, and metro systems

Designed for flexible and realistic layouts

Works separately from default MTR signage

Ideal for builders who want full control over transit signage

⚠️ Important Rules / Warnings:

Do not edit or move the texture files in assets/mtr_custom_resources/; signs may disappear if changed.

Do not rename files or folders — exact names are required.

Backup your world before using this pack, especially in existing builds.

Compatible with MTR v1.19+ only.

Loading order matters: packs loaded after this one may override textures.
